text: Crop: Rice (ধান). Disease: Blast (ব্লাস্ট). Measure type: cultural. Use tolerant varieties BR-12, 15, 16, 24, BRRI dhan33; use seed from healthy plants; balanced fertilizer; organic manure; keep standing water.

Crop: Rice (ধান). Disease: Blast (ব্লাস্ট). Measure type: chemical. Apply an approved fungicide at initial infection only if needed (source names no product or dose). Dose: not specified in source. Timing: initial stage of infection.

Crop: Rice (ধান). Disease: Brown Spot (বাদামী দাগ). Measure type: cultural. Resistant variety; healthy seed; hot water seed soak 53-54 C or cold water soak; keep seedbed moist; organic and balanced fertilizer. Dose: 53-54 C hot water.

Crop: Rice (ধান). Disease: Brown Spot (বাদামী দাগ). Measure type: chemical. Seed treatment with fungicide. Active ingredient: Thiram; Captan; Carbendazim (Bavistin). Product: Bavistin. Dose: not specified in source. Timing: seed treatment.

Crop: Rice (ধান). Disease: Bacterial Leaf Blight (ব্যাকটেরিয়াল পাতা পোড়া). Measure type: cultural. Tolerant variety; balanced fertilizer, urea in three instalments; withhold irrigation 7-8 days to dry soil; apply potash. Active ingredient: Potash fertilizer. Dose: 5 kg potash per bigha (0.33 acre).

Crop: Rice (ধান). Disease: Sheath Blight (শীথ ব্লাইট). Measure type: cultural. Resistant varieties BR-22, BR-23, BRRI dhan34, BRRI dhan41; spacing 25x20 or 25x15 cm, 3 seedlings per hill; remove floating debris; burn dead plants; crop rotation; correct urea dose.
Crop: Rice (ধান). Disease: Sheath Blight (শীথ ব্লাইট). Measure type: chemical. Use an approved fungicide (no product or dose given). Dose: not specified in source.
Crop: Rice (ধান). Disease: Tungro (টুংরো). Measure type: cultural. Tolerant varieties; burn or bury Arali grass; light trap and hand net for vector.
Crop: Rice (ধান). Disease: Leaf Scald. Measure type: cultural. Tolerant variety; no excess urea; keep land dry for some days when disease appears; seed from healthy plants.
Crop: Rice (ধান). Disease: Leaf Scald. Measure type: chemical. If needed, fungicide containing 80% sulphur. Active ingredient: Sulphur 80%. Dose: not specified in source.

Crop: Rice (ধান). Disease: Sheath Rot. Measure type: cultural. Burn affected straw; healthy treated seed; tolerant varieties BR-2,3,5,10,16,25, BRRI dhan26,32,33; balanced fertilizer; keep land dry when disease appears.
Crop: Rice (ধান). Disease: Sheath Rot. Measure type: chemical. Approved fungicide if needed (no product or dose given). Dose: not specified in source.
Crop: Rice (ধান). Disease: Ufra. Measure type: cultural. Tolerant varieties Raida and Bajail; burn leftover straw; control grass weeds; cut top of leaves at initial attack.

Crop: Rice (ধান). Disease: Ufra. Measure type: chemical. Source recommends Furadan 5G against the nematode. Active ingredient: Carbofuran. Product: Furadan 5G. Dose: 2.5 kg per bigha early crop stage; seedling dip 15 g per litre water overnight. Timing: early crop stage.

metadata.flags: REGULATORY_CHECK: 'Furadan 3G' appears in Annex 1 banned-pesticide list of the same document; do not surface to farmers without confirming current DAE status

text: Crop: Rice (ধান). Disease: Foot Rot and Bakanae. Measure type: cultural. Resistant variety; disease-free seed; do not reuse seedbed land; seed soak in fungicide water; soft moist seedbed; dry land after identification; discard infected seedlings; burn infected plants; rotation.
Crop: Rice (ধান). Disease: Bacterial Leaf Streak. Measure type: cultural. Resistant variety; control insects; drain field; balanced fertilizer with less urea.

Crop: Rice (ধান). Disease: Seedling Blight. Measure type: cultural. Treat seed with Vitavax or Thiram before sowing; mix rice bran into seedbed soil; avoid sowing in extreme cold; keep seedbed under standing water some days. Active ingredient: Carboxin (Vitavax); Thiram. Product: Vitabrex/Vitavax; Thirum. Dose: not specified in source. Timing: before sowing.

metadata.flags: dose_missing; source spelling 'Vitabrex' and 'Thirum' kept as written

text: Crop: Rice (ধান). Disease: Seedling Damping Off. Measure type: chemical. Seed treatment before sowing. Active ingredient: Captan; Copper oxychloride. Dose: 4 g Captan per kg seed OR 2 g copper oxychloride per kg seed. Timing: before sowing.
Crop: Rice (ধান). Disease: Seedling Damping Off. Measure type: cultural. Do not keep seedbed under water during germination; avoid sowing in heavy cold; cover seedbed with polythene in cold spells.
Crop: Wheat (গম). Disease: Wheat Blast (গমের ব্লাস্ট). Measure type: cultural. Grow blast-resistant variety BARI Gom 33 as first line of defence (released 2017). Product: BARI Gom 33.

Crop: Wheat (গম). Disease: Wheat Blast (গমের ব্লাস্ট). Measure type: chemical. Fungicide sprays at heading; best field results with three products. Active ingredient: Tebuconazole 50% + Trifloxystrobin 25% (Nativo 75WG); Azoxystrobin 20% + Difenoconazole 12.5% (Amistar Top 325SC); Pyraclostrobin 5% + Metiram 55% (Cabrio Top 60WG). Product: Nativo 75WG; Amistar Top 325SC; Cabrio Top 60WG. Dose: dose not given in abstract. Timing: twice at 13-15 day interval starting at heading stage.

Crop: Wheat (গম). Disease: Wheat Blast (গমের ব্লাস্ট). Measure type: chemical. Mixture of tebuconazole + tricyclazole + pyraclostrobin gave 97% blast reduction, better than single compounds; sprays at booting, pre-heading, heading. Active ingredient: Tebuconazole; Tricyclazole; Pyraclostrobin. Product: Nativo + Trooper 75WP (tricyclazole) cocktail; Filia (Tricyclazole 40% + Propiconazole 12.5%) + Seltima (Pyraclostrobin 10%). Dose: Table text (garbled in extraction): Nativo 6 g per 10 L; Filia 20 ml per 10 L - verify in PDF. Timing: three sprays from booting at 7 day interval (net house).

Crop: Wheat (গম). Disease: Wheat Blast (গমের ব্লাস্ট). Measure type: chemical. Pot study: Nativo and Trooper best; two sprays at pre-heading. Active ingredient: Tebuconazole + Trifloxystrobin; Tricyclazole. Product: Nativo 75WG; Trooper 75WP. Dose: not in abstract. Timing: twice at 10 day interval, pre-heading.

Crop: Potato (আলু). Disease: Late Blight (নাবি ধসা). Measure type: chemical. Mancozeb protectant and Ridomil MZ 63.5 (metalaxyl + mancozeb) are the most commonly used fungicides; trial of 13 fungicides conducted. Active ingredient: Mancozeb; Metalaxyl + Mancozeb. Product: Ridomil MZ 63.5. Dose: dose not in retrieved text.

Crop: Potato (আলু). Disease: Late Blight (নাবি ধসা). Measure type: chemical. Metalaxyl resistance reported in Bangladeshi P. infestans; rely on rotation of fungicide groups, not higher dose. Active ingredient: Metalaxyl (resistance).

Crop: Potato (আলু). Disease: Late Blight (নাবি ধসা). Measure type: chemical. Best performer in a Bangladesh-based test when applied preventively (book abstract by BAU-linked author). Active ingredient: Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64%. Product: Sunoxanil 72WP. Dose: dose not in retrieved text. Timing: prophylactic.

Crop: Potato (আলু). Disease: Early Blight (আগাম ধসা). Measure type: chemical. Fungicide trial: Bicozeb 80WP (mancozeb) significant and cost-effective; Rovral 50WP (iprodione) also good. Active ingredient: Mancozeb; Iprodione. Product: Bicozeb 80WP; Rovral 50WP. Dose: dose not in retrieved text.

Crop: Tomato (টমেটো). Disease: Early Blight (Alternaria leaf blight) (আগাম ধসা). Measure type: biological. Seed treatment with tricho-solution or garlic tablet; field sanitation; spray tricho-solution 3% weekly. Active ingredient: Trichoderma. Product: tricho-solution. Dose: 3%. Timing: every 7 days.

Crop: Tomato (টমেটো). Disease: Early Blight (Alternaria leaf blight) (আগাম ধসা). Measure type: chemical. Spray Dithane M-45. Active ingredient: Mancozeb. Product: Dithane M-45. Dose: not specified in source. Timing: every 7 days.

metadata.flags: dose_missing; REGULATORY_CHECK: some mancozeb brand registrations (e.g. Manzate 200) appear in Annex 1

text: Crop: Tomato (টমেটো). Disease: Late Blight (নাবি ধসা). Measure type: chemical. Disease-free seed; spray BAU-Biofungicide 3%; spray Mancozeb. Active ingredient: Mancozeb. Product: BAU-Biofungicide. Dose: 3% (biofungicide); mancozeb dose not specified. Timing: every 7 days.
Crop: Tomato (টমেটো). Disease: Bacterial Wilt (ব্যাকটেরিয়াজনিত ঢলে পড়া). Measure type: cultural. Disease-free seed and seedbed; if field contaminated rotate with cereals at least 3 years.

Crop: Tomato (টমেটো). Disease: Leaf Curl (virus, whitefly-transmitted) (পাতা কুঁকড়ানো). Measure type: cultural. Seedlings under net; barrier crops; yellow sticky traps; uproot infected plants and weeds.

Crop: Tomato (টমেটো). Disease: Leaf Curl (virus, whitefly-transmitted) (পাতা কুঁকড়ানো). Measure type: chemical. Spray Dimethoate against whitefly vector. Active ingredient: Dimethoate. Dose: not specified in source. Timing: every 10 days.

Crop: Brinjal (বেগুন). Disease: Fruit and Stem Rot / Fruit Blight. Measure type: cultural. Pathogen-free seed; 3-4 year rotation; destroy infected material; control solanaceous weeds; resistant varieties Jessore local, Kata begun, Isharwardi-1; mulch and furrow irrigation.

metadata.disease_en: Fruit and Stem Rot / Fruit Blight

text: Crop: Brinjal (বেগুন). Disease: Fruit and Stem Rot / Fruit Blight. Measure type: chemical. BAU-Biofungicide spray; Bavistin as protectant. Active ingredient: Carbendazim. Product: Bavistin; BAU-Biofungicide. Dose: Bavistin 2 g per litre; BAU-Biofungicide 3%.

metadata.disease_en: Fruit and Stem Rot / Fruit Blight

text: Crop: Brinjal (বেগুন). Disease: Bacterial Wilt (ব্যাকটেরিয়াজনিত ঢলে পড়া). Measure type: chemical. Dip seed before sowing; avoid rotation with okra, tomato, potato; remove affected plants. Active ingredient: Streptomycin sulphate/tetracycline (Streptocycline). Product: Streptocycline. Dose: 1 g per 40 litres water, seed dip 30 minutes. Timing: before sowing.

Crop: Brinjal (বেগুন). Disease: Root Knot Nematode. Measure type: cultural. Remove weed hosts; soil solarisation; fallow with deep ploughing; neem cake 250 kg/ha. Active ingredient: Neem cake. Dose: 250 kg per ha.
Crop: Brinjal (বেগুন). Disease: Root Knot Nematode. Measure type: chemical. Carbofuran 3G granules. Active ingredient: Carbofuran. Dose: 1 kg a.i. per ha.

metadata.flags: REGULATORY_CHECK: 'Furadan 3G' appears in Annex 1 banned list of the same document

text: Crop: Cucurbits (কুমড়া জাতীয় সবজি). Disease: Powdery Mildew (পাউডারি মিলডিউ). Measure type: chemical. Wettable sulphur or dusting sulphur; Thiovit; BAU-Biofungicide. Active ingredient: Sulphur. Product: Thiovit; BAU-Biofungicide. Dose: Wettable sulphur 0.2%; Thiovit 2 g per litre; BAU-Biofungicide 3%. Timing: Thiovit weekly; sulphur once or twice per season.
Crop: Cucurbits (কুমড়া জাতীয় সবজি). Disease: Powdery Mildew (পাউডারি মিলডিউ). Measure type: cultural. Avoid crowded planting; field sanitation.

Crop: Cucurbits (কুমড়া জাতীয় সবজি). Disease: Mosaic Virus (মোজাইক ভাইরাস). Measure type: chemical. Spray insecticide to suppress insect vectors. Active ingredient: Oxydemeton-methyl (Metasystox). Product: Metasystox. Dose: 0.1%.

Crop: Cucurbits (কুমড়া জাতীয় সবজি). Disease: Fruit Rot. Measure type: biological. Soil drench and spray with BAU-Biofungicide; keep fruit off soil; rotation with pepper, tomato, eggplant. Product: BAU-Biofungicide. Dose: 3%.

Crop: Cucurbits (কুমড়া জাতীয় সবজি). Disease: Fusarium Wilt. Measure type: cultural. Resistant cultivars; hot water seed treatment 55 C for 15 min; BAU-Biofungicide seed treatment (3% seed weight) and soil drench; soil drench with carbendazim. Active ingredient: Carbendazim. Product: BAU-Biofungicide. Dose: carbendazim dose not specified.

Crop: Cucurbits (কুমড়া জাতীয় সবজি). Disease: Alternaria Blight and Fruit Rot. Measure type: chemical. Disease-free seed, clean cultivation, rotation; spray Indofil M-45. Active ingredient: Mancozeb. Product: Indofil M-45. Dose: 0.25%. Timing: every 10-15 days.

Crop: Mango (আম). Disease: Powdery Mildew (পাউডারি মিলডিউ). Measure type: chemical. Thiovit; BAU-Biofungicide. Active ingredient: Sulphur. Product: Thiovit; BAU-Biofungicide. Dose: Thiovit 0.2%; BAU-Biofungicide 3%. Timing: Thiovit every 10-15 days; biofungicide every 12 days.

Crop: Mango (আম). Disease: Anthracnose (অ্যানথ্রাকনোজ). Measure type: chemical. Pre-harvest sprays; last spray 15 days before harvest; bag fruits 15 days before harvest. Active ingredient: Hexaconazole; Carbendazim; Copper oxychloride (Cupravit). Product: Cupravit; BAU-Biofungicide. Dose: Hexaconazole 0.01% or Carbendazim 0.1%; Cupravit 0.03%; BAU-Biofungicide 3%. Timing: every 15 days (Cupravit, hexaconazole, carbendazim); every 12 days (biofungicide).
Crop: Mango (আম). Disease: Anthracnose (অ্যানথ্রাকনোজ). Measure type: cultural. Clean cultivation: collect and burn diseased leaves, twigs, fruit.

Crop: Mango (আম). Disease: Die-back. Measure type: chemical. Prune diseased terminals with 15-20 cm healthy portion and paint cut end; spray Cupravit. Active ingredient: Copper oxychloride. Product: Cupravit. Dose: 0.03%. Timing: every 15 days.
